Wrong password 🥺

You're like the warm light dancing,
with the shadows on my wall.
A practice of the sun to show its softness,
A chance to behold the face of love.

There are small, simple moments
where I think to myself,
How lucky I'm to be so close
to a warmth of your magnitude.

You hold the light of the sun,
and you share it with me in ways my body can hold.

The yawn and stretch before you start your day,
the way you call my name,
the wind at your face while we laugh,
while we sing and walk to your favorite songs.

I know if icarus could see me now,
he'd probably ask me, how I did it.
